editorial:
Picture four desperate criminals stumbling into a snow-covered fort in the middle of nowhere, hoping to hide out and wait for the heat to die down. Instead, they find three sisters who seem a little too calm about the whole situation. Right away, you can feel that something is off. The sisters have a secret, and it is not long before a monster shows up to make things worse. The whole movie has a tense, chilly vibe that keeps you on edge from start to finish.

The acting is solid for a TV movie, and the snowy setting really adds to the mood. The pacing moves along nicely without dragging, though some scenes feel a bit rushed near the end. If you enjoy creature features with a survival twist, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the criminals realize the sisters have been feeding travelers to the monster all along to keep it satisfied. When the sisters try to offer up the last criminal, the creature turns on them instead. Only one criminal manages to escape into the freezing snow. The final shot shows the monster still lurking near the fort, hinting that the nightmare is far from over and more victims could follow.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creature features and snowy survival horror.
